entities.name: Imperials
entities.description: Reigning, most powerful organization of modern Kamigawa, founded to help Kyodai manage the merging of mortal and spirit realms.

entities.name: Kyodai
entities.description: Great kami who blesses the Imperials and chooses the Emperor of Kamigawa.

entities.name: Michiko Konda
entities.description: Past ruler whose reign was prosperous and influential.

entities.name: Konda family
entities.description: Descendants of Michiko stripped of hereditary rule by Kyodai.

entities.name: Yamazaki clan
entities.description: Clan that served the Konda military; a young soldier assassinated the emperor's husband.

entities.name: Eiganjo
entities.description: Place that descended into war over the succession.

entities.name: Minamo Academy
entities.description: Rebuilt with a promise of transparency.

events.summary: An emperor dies young without an heir, causing a succession crisis and war in Eiganjo.
events.quote: an emperor died young without an heir, creating a crisis of succession

events.summary: A young Yamazaki soldier assassinates the late emperor's husband and confronts her brother in the throne room.
events.quote: He successfully assassinated the late emperor's husband

events.summary: Kyodai strips the Konda family of rulership; emperors will be chosen by kami.
events.quote: She stripped the Konda family of their hereditary duty as rulers.

events.summary: With Kyodai's guidance, the Imperials usher in an age of peace and prosperity.
events.quote: the Imperials ushered in an age of collective peace and prosperity
